description: This source file defines the 'ConduitContext' class, which is a DbContext implementation for Entity Framework Core. It configures the data model for the application, including entity DbSets and relationship mappings, as well as transaction management logic.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: A DbContext class for Entity Framework Core that manages database access for articles, comments, persons, tags, and relationships, along with transaction handling.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with exception handling and resource disposal.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction and disposes of it.
